items.question: What service levels does Schedule 2 of the MSA set?
items.answer:
Schedule 2 of the MSA sets service levels for the Provider's performance. Specifically, it outlines that the Provider must make the Services available at least 99.5% of each calendar month, excluding scheduled maintenance notified at least five business days in advance [2].

The service levels also specify that for each full hour of unavailability below that level, the Client will receive a service credit of five percent (5%) of the monthly subscription fee [2].

Additionally, service credits in any calendar month are capped at twenty-five percent (25%) of the monthly subscription fee for that month [2].

evidence.quote: Provider will make the Services available at least 99.5% of each calendar month, excluding scheduled maintenance notified at least five (5) business days in advance.

Service credits in any calendar month are capped at twenty-five percent (25%) of the monthly subscription fee for that month.

items.question: What service levels does Schedule 2 of the MSA set?
items.answer:
Schedule 2 of the MSA sets the service levels for the Services provided by Harrowgate Systems Inc. to Voss-Lindqvist AB. According to the MSA, Provider shall provide the Services in accordance with the service levels in Schedule 2 [1].

The specific service levels are outlined in the "Service credit side letter," which states that the Provider will make the Services available at least 99.5% of each calendar month, excluding scheduled maintenance notified at least five business days in advance [2].

Additionally, the side letter specifies that for each full hour of unavailability below that level, the Client will receive a service credit of five percent (5%) of the monthly subscription fee, with service credits in any calendar month capped at twenty-five percent (25%) of the monthly subscription fee [2][2].

evidence.quote: Provider shall provide the Services in accordance with the service levels in Schedule 2.
Provider will make the Services available at least 99.5% of each calendar month, excluding scheduled maintenance notified at least five (5) business days in advance.
For each full hour of unavailability below that level, Client will receive a service credit of five percent (5%) of the monthly subscription fee.
Service credits in any calendar month are capped at twenty-five percent (25%) of the monthly subscription fee for that month.
